User-adopted coverage policy 2026-09-24: separate missing source-analysis support from mapping correctness; no universal <=3% real-data admission cutoff. Preserve original frozen failure. Require independent sampling agreement, source/receipt-grounded explanation of every missing value, dense full-support geometry/sampling control, and explicit per-hemisphere coverage/unavailable-vs-zero display and pick/export provenance. Dropout is possible, not diagnosed from percentage.
Implemented PLSNeuro9eabf09 on qa/coverage-contract-20260924 (/private/tmp/plsneuro-coverage-20260924). Six regression tests and full30-case Workbench comparison pass from fresh git archive. Every NoSupport matches an in-grid nonfinite source voxel plus NonFinite receipt; mapped values require finite source plus Included receipt. Current fixture has no explicit mask; explicit-mask routes need their own mask-grounded checks. Dense index control has zero omissions/mismatches across cortical vertices; it checks sampling/shared placements, not end-to-end transform or anatomical registration. v2 summary keeps frozenCoveragePass=false, adds sourceSupportPass/denseControlPass/samplingQualificationPass=true. No provider kernel/pin/UI changes, full product lanes not run.
Evidence /Users/bbuchsbaum/code/scala/plsneuro/output/group-coverage-20260924 (summary, commands, tests.log, fresh-run.log); archive pinned in docs/verification/large-evidence-manifest.json. Design decision in docs/design-plan.md, detailed scope/provenance findings docs/verification/group-workbench-qa.md.
Provenance investigation: midthickness metadata identifies population-average Conte69 source; TemplateFlow description links HCP and bhr291. Inspected HCP standard mesh README explains correspondence/masks, not exact volumetric coordinates of the pinned anatomy. Existing RealAssets.fslrBasis HCP-convention statement and asserted result source release remain unqualified. Next needs exact asset-to-reference/transform chain and actual result source-template provenance. No default/admission/merge/push. Umbrella stays open.
